item.title: Irate Dem yells back as Trump scolds her: 'You should be ashamed of yourself!'
item.description: An irate Rep. Ilhan Omar (D-MN) again yelled at President Donald Trump during his State of the Union address Tuesday night. item.title: Rambling Trump shatters record for longest State of the Union
item.description: President Donald Trump spoke for more than 90 minutes Tuesday night during his first State of the Union speech of his second presidential term — breaking records for the longest address in history. Trump's SOTU speech was reportedly the longest since at least 1964 and broke the previous record for President Bill Clinton's 2000 address, CNN reported. item.title: Trump mercilessly mocked after 'bragging' about kicking people off of food stamps
item.description: President Donald Trump was swiftly mocked on Tuesday after he bragged about kicking people off food assistance. Trump said during his State of the Union address that his administration helped "lift" 2.4 million people out of the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program, which provides food assistance to more than 41 million people nationwide. His comments came at a time when his administration cut funding for the popular program by more than $186 billion through his "One Big Beautiful Bill Act.
